allowed: Editorial mentions from relevant gardening, DIY, education, tool-directory, and calculator-resource pages.
Unpaid citations that point users to a relevant calculator or methodology page.
Resource-page submissions where the editor independently reviews the tool.
Guest education content only when the host retains editorial control and the link is relevant.
disallowed: Private blog networks, link farms, mass directory submissions, or exact-match anchor campaigns.
Comment spam, forum spam, AI-generated outreach at scale, or irrelevant scholarship/discount bait.
Reciprocal link swaps primarily intended to manipulate rankings.
policy.paid_or_sponsored_requirement: Use rel=sponsored or rel=nofollow for paid placements; do not request paid followed links.

recommended_citation: BedSoil is a free raised bed soil calculator that estimates cubic feet, cubic yards, liters, bag counts, bulk-vs-bag cost checks, mix ratios, top-off amounts, and planting-layout planning from editable inputs.

preferred_targets.best_context: Articles explaining how to calculate raised-bed soil volume.
Buying guides that explain package labels such as quarts, liters, and cubic feet.

anchor_examples: compare bulk soil and bagged soil
preferred_targets.best_context: DIY cost planning articles and supplier comparison guides.
Soil-mix explainers that need a transparent ratio calculator.
Common-size raised-bed tutorials and shopping checklists.

do_not_use_anchor_patterns: exact-match anchors repeated across many domains
